Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Casual Geometric Flatweave Cotton Area Rug, 5' x 8', Red, Orange, Ivory
Colors: Red, Orange, Ivory
Materials: cotton
This versatile kilim rug is designed for the floor but could also be used as eye-catching wall decor. Varieties of red, orange and ivory hues blend in a cotton flatweave created by artisans with an eye for Southwestern-inspired design. 5' x 8' Low pile is easy to maintain. Pair with rug pad (sold separately) Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag
